spec.userPrompt:
Question: Choisissez la phrase correcte : « Lorsque nous sommes arrivés au cinéma, la séance ___ déjà. »

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] avait commencé
B. [WRONG] a déjà commencé
C. [WRONG] commençait déjà
D. [WRONG] aurait déjà commencé

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect (letters: B, C, D)

responses.raw:
TRUE||All wrong answers contain clear grammar errors.

The question requires the plus-que-parfait tense because it describes an action (the session starting) that was completed before another past action (their arrival). Answer B uses the passé composé, which doesn't properly establish the temporal sequence. Answer C uses the imparfait, which describes ongoing or habitual actions rather than completed ones. Answer D uses the conditionnel passé, which introduces an unreal/hypothetical element that doesn't fit the factual context.
